scope: Final prose review of four documentation files after parent integration, camera, ramp, pause, reward and recovery updates. No game, result report, app catalog, artwork or PR-body edits.
source_policy: Parent pre-update snapshots copied from 2026-10-24-2/.cache/rework-before-final-docs. Previous originals preserved. Additional immediate pre-proofreading snapshots retained separately.
tool_record_policy: Tool-generated state remains local under its own ignored directories; this portable summary records run ids and full final hashes.
changes_by_reviewer: README: clarify sufficient-speed crossing without Space; change obsolete character production-in-progress wording to completed production.
REWORK: change repeated future production wording to completed production, preserving future comparison and adoption criteria.
AGENTS and IMPLEMENTATION: remove surplus blank lines only.
verification_boundary: Yomiyasu execution and matching hashes do not prove readability, preserved meaning or gameplay acceptance. All candidates were manually compared against originals and raw sources.
